sculpt_chest_pack_lid.author: sculpted for this project
sculpt_chest_pack_lid.notes: Iron-banded pack chest for the landmark puzzles (gameplay/wilds-puzzles.js makeChestAt): bevelled planks with gaps, corner posts, iron bands and rivets, brass caps, lock plate, ring handles; barrel lid of staves with bevelled gable ends. chest_pack = body (origin ground centre, front +Z), chest_pack_lid = lid (origin on the hinge line; the game mounts it at (0, 0.54, -0.31) and swings it about X). LOD tris 2652 / 1140 / 188. Vertex colour only (COLOR_0 linear rgb, written once).
